resources.string: L4S firmware required. USB-C OTG carries control only; voice uses the handheld microphone. One half-duplex radio with independent RX/TX frequencies. Turn off USB paddle/handkey mode before connecting. Both frequencies stay fixed throughout TX and resume tracking after TX ends.
TX/RX Doppler held until transmission ends
Linear transponders use native CW. SSB transmission is not supported.
Connect to the L4S radio first. You can prepare CW text here; transmission is disabled.
Select a transponder and start tracking; wait until the radio is ready.
CW text requires a CW or linear transponder. FM uses hold-to-talk PTT.
The connected firmware does not report CW text support.
Stop the current transmission and confirm PTT OFF before sending CW.
